svg.text: cwd, clock: the part that moves
claimed only at a step boundary
every event of the turn appends here
one result per call, in model order
the catalog is context: cheap, and always visible
owner fence: only caller_id may wait or kill
a wakeup lands in the inbox, never in the log
the parent takes back one result, not a transcript
every box above is a plugin, and every registration is reversible
